description: This file contains internal socket handling functions for Windows, including socket address retrieval, binding, and extension function loading, with specific focus on Windows socket API interoperability.

methods.name: GetSockName
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of a socket.

methods.name: GetPeerName
methods.description: Retrieves the remote address of a connected socket.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds a socket to an address.

methods.name: ConnectEx
methods.description: Initiates a connection on a socket using the ConnectEx extension.
